epic.title: In-App Messaging & Trade Chat
epic.description: Enable retail investors to discuss trade ideas, share live ticker cards, and build community within xCube without context-switching to external platforms.
epic.businessValue: Reduces 6–8 minute execution gap from external chat tools, increasing trade conversion by an estimated 18%. Users who engage in chat are 3.4× more likely to remain active 30 days later.
epic.prdLink: PRD: In-App Messaging & Trade Chat — xCube
epic.definitionOfDone: Users can create or join topic-based channels, send text messages with live ticker cards, and receive messages in under 500ms during market hours

features.title: Channel Management
features.description: Users can create, join, and leave topic-based trading channels with persistent membership.
acceptanceCriteria: Users can browse a directory of public channels by topic (ticker symbols, trading strategies, market sectors)
Users can create new channels by specifying a name, topic, and privacy setting (public or private)
Channel creators can invite members to private channels via a shareable link
Users can leave channels at any time, with the option to rejoin later

userJourneys: Journey 1: Join a topic channel and discuss a ticker

features.title: Real-time Text Messaging
features.description: Users can send and receive text messages in channels with sub-second latency during market hours.
acceptanceCriteria: Messages delivered to all channel members within 500ms at peak load
Messages persist for 7 years to meet compliance requirements
Offline messages sync when user reconnects to the internet
Messages display sender name, timestamp, and read/delivered status

userJourneys: Journey 3: Send a message in a channel

features.title: Live Ticker Card Sharing
features.description: Users can embed live-updating ticker price cards directly into any message.
acceptanceCriteria: Users can attach a ticker card from any instrument detail screen via a 'Share to Chat' button
Ticker cards render in under 200ms and display current price, % change, and timestamp
Tapping a ticker card navigates the recipient to the instrument detail screen with a pre-filled buy order
Ticker cards update in real time during market hours without requiring a message refresh

userJourneys: Journey 2: Share a live ticker card in a message

outOfScope: Content moderation & compliance — deferred to Phase 2
Video chat or screen sharing — not planned for MVP
Direct messages (1:1 DMs) — MVP focuses on group channels only
Desktop or web app — mobile-only for MVP
